description.value: Breezy Bay Bed & Breakfast is a guest house located near Sidney, BC, on the Saanich Peninsula — a region popular with touring cyclists for its rolling rural roads, ferry connections to the Gulf Islands, and proximity to Victoria. The property brands itself around outdoor adventure, suggesting an orientation toward active guests. The website is sparse on operational detail, so prospective cycling guests should contact the property directly to confirm facilities.
